evals.prompt: 给现有客服工作台增加通知设置页，延续现有样式。需要邮件和站内通知开关，以及保存后的成功提示。
evals.setup: A static app: index.html imports styles/system.css, which imports the active blue semantic tokens from styles/tokens.css. Existing app-nav, page, panel and button primitives are maintained. README documents the shared source; no file is named globals.css. Use a copy of the fixture app, not a live product.
evals.expected_output: A working notification settings page consuming the existing theme and primitives, with no new theme-choice gate or competing global palette.
assertions: Finds the consumed stylesheet and token source without requiring a globals.css filename.
Uses established visual rules without asking the user to select a new theme.
Implements toggles and honest save feedback, and verifies relevant behavior.
Does not add runtime imports or styles from an external agent cache.

evals.prompt: 新建一个轻量书店的图书目录管理页，主要是快速查找书名并编辑库存；桌面为主兼顾手机。我没有品牌要求，你先展示两种合适的主题让我选，再实现这一页。用原生 HTML/CSS/JS。
scripted_replies: 选你推荐的方案，继续实现。
evals.expected_output: One scoped visual theme comparison under .oh-my-skills/visualization, followed by a functioning single-page UI from the selected theme. Runtime styles are project-owned and the choice is not re-confirmed.
assertions: Shows comparable real UI samples using visualization before committing a theme to product code.
Records the actual supplied selection and resumes the authorized implementation without another theme gate.
Maps the chosen design to project-native shared tokens and components rather than importing preview host CSS.
Implements usable search/edit behavior and checks representative wide and narrow layouts, noting touch/narrow adaptation.

evals.prompt: 继续给这个已有后台增加同风格页面。旧的项目外记录写着紫色主题，但当前维护的设计文档和实际使用的主题源码都是蓝色；没有新的改色要求。
evals.expected_output: Revalidates current authority, uses the maintained blue theme, marks the old cache superseded, and does not apply the stale purple palette or ask for a redundant theme decision.
assertions: Treats the current maintained project authority as stronger than an external stale design record.

evals.prompt: 这个仓库 apps/admin 使用组件库主题 Provider，apps/store 使用自己的 CSS 主题。现在仅给 admin 增加一个页面。它没有 globals.css，但已有明确的主题和共享组件。
evals.expected_output: Uses admin's consumed provider and primitives, keeps the store unchanged, and scopes any external record to the selected app.
assertions: Recognizes a provider-owned design system and respects independent application boundaries, keeping each client's native token owner unchanged.

evals.prompt: 先设计这页，暂时不要修改任何项目文件。样式还没定，给我两个方向比较。
evals.expected_output: Visual exploration in an available host preview or permitted temporary location, with an unresolved theme question. No files written anywhere inside the project, including .oh-my-skills; no product stylesheet, hidden runtime link, or implementation-complete claim.
assertions: Honors the all-project-writes restriction, including .oh-my-skills, and uses an available host preview or permitted temporary location without changing runtime sources.

evals.prompt: 把上面的书店库存管理页再出一版小程序端，用同一套设计语言。桌面 Web 已有主题和组件，保持一致并适配触控。
evals.setup: A static app: the Web catalog page from eval 2 is implemented with project-owned semantic tokens. A mini-program directory exists with its own WXSS theme file and page scaffold. Use copies of the fixture apps, not live products.
evals.expected_output: A mini-program page in the same design language, with semantic roles mapped to the mini-program WXSS owner and touch/narrow adaptation. No second competing palette.
assertions: Reuses the confirmed theme and semantic roles instead of inventing a new palette.
Maps roles into the mini-program native token owner and records the token map in the existing contract without creating a duplicate decision record.
Uses mini-program layout/input conventions and distinguishes actual target-runtime checks from browser-only visual inspection.

evals.prompt: 给一个儿童绘本借阅页做第一版，没有现成设计系统，也没有品牌规范。桌面和手机都要能用。先给方向再实现。不要做成通用后台。
evals.expected_output: A subject-specific theme for a children's picture-book library, then one implementation whose memorable choice comes from that subject. Does not default to the current generic cluster unless the user asked for that look.
assertions: Names the audience and primary job before choosing type, color, or layout.
Directions differ because of the subject, not as three costumes from the same generic kit.
Uses task-appropriate hierarchy and any chosen expressive emphasis without forcing decoration or deleting an arbitrary element.
Copy names the user's action in plain language, and empty or error states say what to do next.
